title: Authentication Bypass via SQL Injection
impact: An attacker can bypass authentication controls and log in as the primary administrator account without valid credentials. This grants full administrative access to user accounts and sensitive application data.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database authentication lookups instead of string concatenation. Enforce strict input validation and apply the principle of least privilege to database accounts.

title: Database Data Extraction via UNION SQL Injection
impact: An attacker can extract sensitive records from arbitrary database tables including user email addresses and password hashes. Exposed credentials can be cracked offline to compromise customer and administrator accounts.
remediation: Replace dynamic SQL string concatenation in product search queries with parameterized prepared statements or an ORM. Restrict database user permissions so the web application cannot query unrelated tables.

title: DOM-Based Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in Search
impact: An attacker can craft a malicious link that executes arbitrary JavaScript in a victim's browser session when opened. This enables session token theft, unauthorized actions on behalf of the user, or phishing redirects.
remediation: Sanitize and contextually encode all user-supplied query parameters before rendering them in the DOM. Implement a strong Content Security Policy (CSP) that blocks inline script execution and javascript: URIs.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Customer Feedback
impact: Malicious HTML or script payloads submitted by an attacker are persisted in the database and rendered to administrators viewing the feedback dashboard. This allows persistent script execution in privileged user sessions, leading to account takeover or data exfiltration.
remediation: Apply strict server-side HTML sanitization using an allowlist library before storing user feedback in the database. Ensure frontend templates escape dynamic output by default rather than rendering raw HTML.
